metadata.title: PV Construction — Trusted Building in Puerto Vallarta
metadata.description: Leading construction platform for foreign investors in Puerto Vallarta, Bahía de Banderas and Nayarit. New builds, remodeling, luxury projects. 100% legal, fully licensed in Mexico.

hero.title: Build Your Dream in
hero.subtitle: We connect foreign investors with Mexico's top certified builders. 100% legal, transparent, and socially responsible.
hero.trustLine: 200+ completed projects • Verified Mexican licenses • Social purpose company

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: We offer a complete range of construction services for foreign and local investors in the Puerto Vallarta and Bahía de Banderas area.

newBuild.title: New Construction
newBuild.description: From design to key handover. Residential and luxury builds with premium materials and full permit compliance.

remodel.title: Remodeling
remodel.description: Transform your existing property. Full renovations, kitchen and bathroom upgrades, additions and structural improvements.

luxury.title: Luxury Projects
luxury.description: Ocean-view villas, premium beach houses, high-end finishes. For clients who demand the extraordinary.

commercial.title: Commercial
commercial.description: Restaurants, boutique hotels, offices and commercial spaces. Functional design that maximizes your investment.

permits.title: Permits & Paperwork
permits.description: We navigate Mexico's permit system for you. Building permits, environmental impact, land use and more.

landPurchase.title: Land Purchase
landPurchase.description: We advise you on legal land purchases. Bank trust (fideicomiso), due diligence and title verification.

designStudios.title: Design Studios
designStudios.description: Custom design studios with branding, UI/UX, and visual identity services.

marketplaces.title: Marketplaces
marketplaces.description: Multi‑vendor marketplace platforms with integrated payments and reviews.

directories.title: Directories
directories.description: Advanced directory listings with geo‑filtering and lead generation.

process.title: Our Process
process.description: Discovery, Design, Development, Launch – a streamlined workflow.

trust.title: Why Trust Us?

licensed.title: 100% Licensed
licensed.description: Registered RFC, municipal license, contractors with verified IMSS and INFONAVIT compliance.

american.title: American-Mexican Team
american.description: We understand both cultures. Bilingual communication and international standards.

social.title: Social Purpose Company
social.description: For every project, we plant trees and reinvest in the community. Verifiable impact.

transparent.title: Full Transparency
transparent.description: Real-time permit tracking, detailed budgets and clear timelines.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: We are an American-Mexican collective of construction professionals, united by the vision of doing things right in Puerto Vallarta.
about.missionText: To be the most trusted construction platform for foreign investors in Puerto Vallarta and Nayarit, creating a positive social impact with every project.
about.legalDescription: We operate as a company incorporated in Mexico (S. de R.L. de C.V.) with RFC, municipal license, SAT registration and contractors registered with IMSS. We are not an informal operation — we are the legal and professional alternative.
about.socialDescription: A portion of profits from every project is reinvested in the community: planting trees to offset cement impact, supporting local families, and verifiable transparency on blockchain.
